\begin{example} \end{example}[Exercise 25.14: integrate the Ricci-flow gradient estimate] 1. ch25:25.14\group Integrated Harnack Inequalities Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0342 ↗ thm:chow-iii-li-yau-ricci-flow Derive Corollary 3 from the differential estimate. \end{example}
Proof

Along a path $\gamma $, differentiate $\log u(\gamma (\tau ),\tau )$, insert the differential Harnack estimate, and apply $a|X|^2+\langle X,Y\rangle \geq -|Y|^2/(4a)$ with $a=1-\varepsilon $. Integrating $1/\tau $ gives the time-ratio factor; taking the constant-speed minimizing $\widetilde g$-geodesic and applying metric comparison gives the Gaussian factor.
